source.title: Competition Safety Policy
source.content:
We thank you for your patience as the Board has been discussing and receiving input from Leaders and Seniors regarding the current COVID-19 situation.

The WCA is proud to present our new [Competition Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf) with which we are asking all Staff members and competitors to familiarize themselves as competitions are reintroduced to their local communities. All competitions must adhere to this policy until it is revoked by the WCA Board.

The safety of our competitors and Staff are paramount to ensure that competitions will be successful into the future. Although competitions may look different, we still hope to celebrate the joy of cubing together as we can. Please reach out to us if you have any questions about the safety policies.

translation.title: 《比赛安全政策》
translation.content:
董事会一直在讨论当前的新冠疫情情况，并听取各负责人和高级代表的意见。感谢大家耐心等待。

WCA 现公布新的[《比赛安全政策》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf)。随着各地逐步恢复比赛，我们请所有工作人员和选手熟悉这份政策。在 WCA 董事会撤销该政策之前，所有比赛都必须遵守。

选手和工作人员的安全至关重要，也是今后比赛能顺利开展的前提。虽然比赛的形式可能与以往有所不同，但我们仍希望尽可能与大家一起享受魔方的乐趣。如对安全政策有任何疑问，请联系我们。
